rationale: The message reports concrete probe results about multiple commands/options, summarizing observed behavior rather than asking or proposing. It also synthesizes findings across flatten, table, fixlengths, and fmt.

evidence.text: Probes: flatten default output ; -n uses numeric headers 0,1 and separator after every record incl final.

table defaults columns separated 2 spaces, min width 2;  yielded 4 spaces for 1-char col (width is minimum, pad adds). fixlengths no --length requires file and pads to max; --length accepts stdin, truncates/pads. fmt --quote-always quotes every field; --crlf uses CRLF.
